name: MagicDots for WooCommerce
author: MagicDots

sections.description:
MagicDots is an AI-powered growth platform for WooCommerce stores. When connected through this plugin, it helps recover revenue your store might otherwise lose, estimate your profitability, and improve how your products show up in AI assistants like ChatGPT.

Important — please read: this plugin is a connector. It links your WooCommerce store to your MagicDots account, where all the work happens in the cloud. It runs no AI and sends no email from your site, and it does nothing on its own. A MagicDots account is required (new accounts include a 14-day free trial) — create one at magicdots.io, connect your store in a couple of minutes, and MagicDots takes it from there.

Recover lost revenue

Recover abandoned carts with automated follow-ups.

  • Timed email and WhatsApp follow-ups reach shoppers who leave without buying.
  • Premium, on-brand emails with your logo, product images and order totals.
  • AI-generated copy written once at setup, then reused on every send.
  • One-click cart restore rebuilds the shopper’s full multi-item cart, ready to check out.

Understand and improve your AI visibility

See — and improve — how your products show up when shoppers ask AI assistants for recommendations.

  • Track your visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Copilot.
  • Per-product issues detected automatically, with ready-to-use optimized content.
  • Real AI-answer checks, plus a competitor and retailer snapshot for your niche.
  • (This is what “AI visibility” — also called AEO or GEO — means for your store.)

Understand your profit

Stop guessing what you actually make on each sale.

  • Estimated net profit per order and per product, calculated from the costs, fees and taxes you configure.
  • Break-even, margins, marketing-spend tracking and revenue attribution, all in one place.
  • Flexible tax and cost models for different markets.

Grow and keep your customers

  • Customer segmentation, a health score per customer, and a recommended next best action.
  • Track attributed visits and revenue by channel — including shoppers who arrive from AI assistants.

Also included

  • Product review requests — branded review invitations sent automatically after an order is paid or delivered.
  • Marketing automation — win-back, VIP, re-engagement and replenishment campaigns with single-use discount coupons.
  • WhatsApp chat widget — an optional storefront chat button.

What the plugin does on your site

The plugin’s footprint on WordPress is small, transparent and fully under your control:

  • Generates a WooCommerce REST API key and registers webhooks so MagicDots can sync your data.
  • Periodically syncs orders, products and customers using Action Scheduler background jobs.
  • Loads a small first-party analytics pixel (with signed per-page tokens) to attribute visits and capture abandoned carts, using server-side, HMAC-signed checkout identity.
  • Optionally shows a WhatsApp chat button on the storefront — only when you enable it and set a phone number.
  • Restores a shopper’s multi-item cart from a recovery link.
  • Is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Privacy and control

MagicDots is built to be trustworthy by default. Nothing is sent anywhere until you explicitly connect your store from the plugin’s settings page — there is no hidden data collection on activation. Storefront analytics carry no personal data; shopper contact details are shared only through the order, customer, cart and checkout-identity flows needed to power recovery, reviews and marketing, and checkout identity is subject to your account’s consent settings. You can disconnect at any time, which stops all data exchange, and every endpoint we use is listed in the External services section below.

External services

This plugin connects your site to MagicDots, a third-party SaaS operated by MagicDots, to provide the functionality described above. Connecting your store (which you do explicitly from the plugin’s settings page) is what enables this data exchange — nothing is sent before you connect.

Data is transmitted to the MagicDots API at your configured account URL (e.g. https://app.magicdots.io) in the following cases:

  • On connect: your store URL, a freshly generated WooCommerce REST API key/secret, a generated webhook secret, and plugin/WooCommerce/WordPress versions — sent to /api/integrations/woocommerce/connect.
  • Orders: order line items, totals, coupons and customer contact details (name, email, phone) — sent on order webhooks and on a periodic sync to /api/webhooks/woocommerce and /api/integrations/woocommerce/sync.
  • Customers: customer name, email and phone (including guest orders) — sent on a periodic sync.
  • Abandoned carts: cart contents and, when available, the shopper’s name/email/phone — sent on cart-update webhooks.
  • Checkout identity: a shopper’s email/phone/name entered at checkout — sent to /api/v1/carts/identity to attach an abandoned cart to a contact (subject to your account’s consent settings).
  • Storefront analytics: page views, add-to-cart events, referrer and UTM parameters (no personal data) — sent to /api/v1/track and /api/v1/traffic.
  • WhatsApp widget: widget configuration is fetched from /api/v1/whatsapp-config; button clicks are logged to /api/tracker/whatsapp-click (no personal data).

By connecting your store you agree to the MagicDots Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://magicdots.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://magicdots.io/privacy

You can disconnect at any time from the plugin’s settings page, which stops all data exchange.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce first (it is required).
  2. Install and activate MagicDots for WooCommerce.
  3. Create a MagicDots account at magicdots.io — new accounts include a 14-day free trial — and add your store.
  4. Copy the connection details from your MagicDots dashboard.
  5. In WordPress, go to Settings → MagicDots for WooCommerce and connect your store.
  6. That’s it — MagicDots begins syncing in the background, and you manage recovery, reviews, marketing, profit and AI visibility from your MagicDots dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a MagicDots account?

Yes. The plugin is a connector to the MagicDots cloud service; it does nothing until you connect an account. You can create one at magicdots.io and start a 14-day free trial.

Is MagicDots free?

The plugin is free to install. MagicDots is a subscription service that includes a 14-day free trial for new accounts. See magicdots.io for details.

Does the plugin run AI or send email from my site?

No. Your WordPress site never runs AI and never sends email. All AI copywriting, automation and emails happen in the MagicDots cloud. The plugin only syncs data and renders the optional widgets your account is configured for.

What data leaves my site?

Only what MagicDots needs to power recovery, reviews, marketing and analytics — store, order, customer and cart data — and only after you explicitly connect your store. Storefront analytics carry no personal data. The full, itemized list is in the “External services” section above.

Is MagicDots privacy-friendly?

Yes, by design. Nothing is transmitted until you connect, checkout identity respects your account’s consent settings, and you can disconnect at any time to stop all data exchange. Review the MagicDots Terms of Service and Privacy Policy linked above before connecting.

How do I stop MagicDots from processing my data?

Disconnect your store from the plugin’s settings page. This immediately stops all syncing and data exchange.

Does it slow down my store?

The impact is minimal. Syncing runs in the background through Action Scheduler, the storefront pixel is lightweight and first-party, and most processing happens in the MagicDots cloud, not on your server.

Which AI assistants does AI Visibility cover?

ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Copilot. MagicDots checks how your products appear, flags per-product issues, and suggests optimized content.

Do I need any coding?

No. Install, activate, and connect from the settings page. There is nothing to configure in code.

Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin declares full HPOS compatibility.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fix: disconnecting the store now verifies that the saved connection was actually removed, instead of reporting success without checking.
  • Fix: the disconnect notification to MagicDots is sent through the same request path as the rest of the plugin, and its result is checked — a failed notification is reported instead of being silently ignored.
  • Fix: the disconnect confirmation is now inline instead of a blocking browser dialog, so the progress state stays visible and the dialog no longer lingers on screen.
  • Fix: disconnecting no longer fails with a fatal error if WooCommerce (and with it Action Scheduler) has been deactivated.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release. Connector for the MagicDots cloud platform: order/product/customer sync via Action Scheduler, abandoned-cart capture with server-side (HMAC-signed) checkout identity, first-party storefront analytics pixel with signed per-page tokens, optional WhatsApp widget, and multi-item cart restore. HPOS compatible.

screenshots.caption: MagicDots at a glance — one platform to recover revenue, monitor AI visibility, track net profit and grow.
Profit Dashboard — your estimated net profit after the costs, fees and taxes you configure, with a plain-language explanation of what changed (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
Overview — your revenue command center: recovered revenue, carts at risk, AI visibility and customers at a glance (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
AI Visibility, per product — the signals AI assistants look for, what your product is missing, and ready-to-use optimized content (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
Growth / AI Traffic — visits, orders and revenue by acquisition channel, including traffic from AI assistants (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
Cart Recovery — abandoned carts with contribution margin and one-click email or WhatsApp follow-up (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
Marketing & Offers — eligible customers, campaign performance and single-use coupon offers (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
Products — your catalog with cost, price, contribution margin and ROI per product (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
AI Visibility, store radar — which brands and retailers dominate AI answers in your niche, and where you can gain visibility (shown in the MagicDots dashboard).
